lines.zh: 我走得慢，脚掌压得木板响。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and the boards groan.

lines.zh: 身上的补丁一层压一层。
lines.en: My patches lie layer over layer.

lines.zh: 帽子挂在头上，晃也不掉。
lines.en: The hat rides my head without slipping.

lines.zh: 我在走廊里晃荡，没有方向。
lines.en: I drift through the hall with no direction.
My gait is not a living man's.
My nails drag along the wall as I pass.
I have walked this floor many times.
My steps halt at a door, then move on.
I need no reason for it.
The light flickers, and I keep walking.
A little light leaks between the boards.
I turn and go slowly back.
I stand and let my head tilt over.
My teeth show and will not close.
My patches are large and small.
I am listening to the building.
The hat sinks over my eyes.

lines.zh: 我身上的补丁，是自己缝的。
lines.en: I stitched these patches myself.
My fingers open and close.
Someone closed a door.
I did not go to look.
I like this stretch of quiet.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖过整条走廊。
lines.en: My shadow stretches down the hall.
The night air is a little damp.
A layer of dust has settled in my hat.
The door at the hall's end stands half open.
I look a long time and do not go.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌压着同一块木板。
lines.en: My feet press the same board.

lines.zh: 你在我看见你之前就看见我了。
lines.en: You saw me before I saw you.
That changes nothing.
The light in your hand shakes.
I am not fond of light.
You are standing close to the door.
The door is not a way out.
You glanced behind you.
So did I.
You are younger than I expected.
Youth will not help much.
I hear your breathing clearly.

lines.zh: 我把头偏过去，看你剩下的那半边脸。
lines.en: I tilt my head to your remaining half face.
You stand inside my shadow.
You have not run yet.
Good; do not run.

lines.zh: 我身后还站着三个小的。
lines.en: Three little ones stand behind me.
The handle must be cold.
You look back at how long the hall is.
The cloth is torn open.
It is hollow, so the sound is dull.

lines.zh: 布面被撕开，里面是空的。
lines.en: The cloth is torn, and there's nothing inside.
A patch has come off.
That struck a joint.
I did not cry out.
I grind my teeth once.
You are stronger than I thought.
This body is not falling yet.
I raise my head to you.
I do not eat.
There is no stomach inside this body.
Hold it long and your arm will ache.
I can smell it.
It is simply of no use.
My teeth are fixed in place.

lines.zh: 你把它放下，我也不会捡。
lines.en: Set it down and I still will not pick it up.
You are the only one here who gets hungry.
Keep it; you may need it.
I am not hungry, and never have been.
You hit me and bounced away.

lines.zh: 我的补丁比你的衣服硬。
lines.en: My patches are harder than your clothes.
You stepped on my big foot.
I felt not a thing.
Do not stand beneath my arm.
Both ends of the hall are shut.
Let me pass.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀蹭到我的手指。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my fingers.
I have lifted it.
You edged back one small step.
This body is for people to look at.
This shell is hollow.

lines.zh: 你对着我说这个，不合适。
lines.en: Saying that to me does not fit.
My joints are only for walking.
Take a step back.
Let that subject end.
I will not answer that.
Your laugh is strange.
You had better go soon.
I do not mean to keep you company.
Something dropped to the floor.
I see it.
This back will not bend.
My fingers are too thick to pinch it.
Pick it up.
It belongs on the floor.
I step over it.
It made a sound under my foot.
Do not blame me; I did not see it.
There is a lot of litter here.
You struck me once.
I stop and turn my head.
I had not meant to notice you.
Now it is different.
I know where you are.
I will not keep looking about.
I will give that back.
This hall has only one way.
Do not think of slipping past the door.
Then come.

lines.zh: 我原本只是在走廊里晃。
lines.en: I was only drifting down the hall.
You changed that.
Every finger of mine is open.
This blow is no accident.
How many steps can you still give?
Count them.
I walk toward you step by step.
Not fast, and never stopping.
Your light rests on me.
I do not dodge.
You have backed to the stairwell.
Upstairs is empty.
I hear your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你踩响的地方我都知道。
lines.en: I know every board you make sound.
You will break before I do.
I do not breathe.

lines.zh: 我的帽子遮着上半张脸。
lines.en: My hat covers the upper half of my face.
My mouth is enough to read.
You have turned three times.
I saw all of it.
The floor announces you for me.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块木板特别响。
lines.en: The board you stepped on is especially loud.
I heard it bend.
You are edging toward the stairs.
I swing a hand down.
My fingers dig into your shoulder.
This one is not heavy.
But my hand is bigger than your face.
I shove you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我另一只手也抬起来了。
lines.en: My other hand is rising too.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一只，挡不住两只。
lines.en: You stop one, not both.
That will keep you up all night.
I did not stop.
The echo in this hall is loud.

lines.zh: 我这一掌拍在你的肩膀上。
lines.en: My palm lands on your shoulder.
You are pressed into a stoop.
This one is the follow-up.
That one put you back two steps.
My fingers rake downward.
Do you hear my joints?

lines.zh: 走廊的灯一盏一盏灭了。
lines.en: The hall lights go out one by one.
I stand under the last of them.
There is no face under the hat.

lines.zh: 这里和我记得的不一样。
lines.en: This is not as I remember it.
Old dust clings to my patches.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，木板响了一声。
lines.en: I lift a foot and a board creaks.
The doors are all behind me.
There is nobody ahead.
Today will be quiet too.
I walk slowly out.
One of my patches is new.
Someone just replaced it.
I do not know who.
I move only after the lights die.
The wall is cold; I walk along it.
There are footsteps behind a door.
I do not enter that door.
There is a guest tonight.

lines.zh: 布面烧起来，火里有旧棉味。
lines.en: The cloth catches, and the fire smells of old cotton.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，一路响。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs, clattering the whole way.
Water pours in through the seams of my patches.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀到墙上，帽子飞了。
lines.en: The blast throws me to the wall and my hat flies off.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的关节一下僵住。
lines.en: That light locks my joints up.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只是一天天旧。
lines.en: I never eat; I only age.
Lightning runs from my hat to my soles.

lines.zh: 脚下的木板没有了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The boards are gone and I fall.
